Find the sum of the digits of a number.

Supplied answer
n = int(input("Enter a number: "))
total = 0
while n > 0:
    total += n % 10
    n //= 10 # NOT n // 10 - it must be reassigned
print("Sum of digits =", total)
Note: n // 10 alone does nothing. You must write n = n // 10 or n //= 10.
